reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Ready-made reports for your events and teams. Download them as Excel, CSV or PDF, or have them emailed to you.
reports.noAccessBody: Your role can't open any report. Ask a vetting administrator for Reports View.

picker.label: Choose a report
picker.available: {count, plural, one {{n} of {total} report available to you} other {{n} of {total} reports available to you}}
picker.lockedHint: You can't open this report. Who can open it: {access}

descriptions.vettingStatus: Every request with its registration, payment, vetting and badge status.
descriptions.timePerStage: Time spent at each stage, per team and reviewer.
descriptions.lateRequests: Open requests past their time limit, with who has them.
descriptions.reviewerActivity: Requests claimed and decisions made by each reviewer.
descriptions.automation: Requests approved by rule, fast-tracked or rejected by rule.
descriptions.listMatches: Blacklist and watchlist matches, with how each was decided.
descriptions.listEntries: Blacklist and watchlist entries, soonest end date first.
descriptions.activityLog: Every action on every request, or the full history of one.

filters.label: Report filters
filters.requestIdHint: Showing the full history of {id}, whatever the dates.
filters.noDates: Dates don't apply to this report: it shows entries as they are today.
filters.noDatesLate: Dates don't apply to this report: it shows requests that are late right now.

view.masked: ID and passport numbers are partly hidden and Screening Hold shows as Under review, because you don't have Blacklist View.

empty.title: Nothing to show
empty.filtered: Try a wider date range or fewer filters.
empty.vettingStatus: No requests were submitted in these dates.
empty.timePerStage: No request entered a stage in these dates.
empty.lateRequests: No open request is past its time limit. Everything is on time.
empty.reviewerActivity: No reviewer claimed or decided a request in these dates.
empty.listMatches: No list matches were found in these dates.
empty.listEntries: There are no list entries for this event.
empty.activityLogOne: No history found for {id}. Check the request ID.

phase2.title: Automation comes in Phase 2
phase2.body: Auto-approval rules and fast-track are part of Phase 2, so no request is decided by rule yet. Once they are switched on, this report will show what was approved by rule, fast-tracked or rejected by rule.

download.xlsxHint: Opens in Excel or Google Sheets
download.pdfHint: Opens the print dialog: choose Save as PDF
download.done: {count, plural, one {{report} downloaded: {n} row} other {{report} downloaded: {n} rows}}
download.printReady: {report} is ready to print. Choose Save as PDF.

schedule.title: Email this report
schedule.description: {report} will be emailed to {email} with the filters you have now.
schedule.ownerNote: It runs with your access at the time it's sent. If you lose access to this report, the schedule pauses.
schedule.rangeNote: Each email covers the same number of days as your date range, ending on the day it's sent.

schedules.title: Scheduled reports
schedules.subtitle: Reports emailed to you. They run with your access.
schedules.emptyBody: Use Email this report to get a report daily or weekly.
schedules.pausedHint: Paused because you no longer have access to this report.

downloads.title: Downloads log
downloads.subtitle: Every download is logged, including scheduled emails.

errors.noExport: You need Reports Export to download or schedule reports.
errors.invalid: Check the schedule settings and try again.
